title: Inside the Holy Sect
next_chapter_hook: A Holy Sect Elder suddenly appeared, questioning why Ye Qing was traveling with a Righteous Path Disciple. Chen Ji's heart sank—the chess piece he had long arranged had now become a blade hanging over his head.

text.content: The stone door at the end of the corridor slid open silently. A strong scent of blood mixed with some kind of诡异的甜腻香味 hit him in waves. Chen Ji's footsteps faltered. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice echoed in his mind, carrying an unprecedented gravity: 'Be careful, this scent is all too familiar to this old man—it is Soul Refining Incense, used to suppress the Heavenly Fate resistance within the living.' He took a deep breath, suppressing the nausea rising in his chest. His gaze pierced through the dim light and landed on the scene beyond the door—his entire body instantly froze.

A massive circular altar dominated the entire space. Around the altar stood twelve pitch-black stone pillars, each covered with densely packed blood-colored runes. Between the pillars hung dozens of crystal-like transparent cocoons, within which curled human silhouettes were faintly visible—those were not cocoons, but living people. Some still微弱地struggling着 within the cocoons, while others had already withered into desiccated corpses, some kind of essence being slowly extracted from them, flowing through the blood-colored runes toward the massive bronze cauldron at the altar's center.

dialogue.content: 'See it now?' Mo Xiansheng's voice reverberated in Chen Ji's mind, dripping with chilling intent, 'This is the Holy Sect's Heavenly Fate Lock Key plan. They extract the Heavenly Fate power from cultivators, gathering it in specific containers, preparing to forcibly open a door that should never be opened. The people in those cocoons—captured scattered cultivators and mortals from across the lands—some don't even know why they ended up here.'

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers slowly clenched within his sleeve, his knuckles turning white. His gaze swept across those cocoons as he silently counted—forty-seven. Forty-seven lives, reduced to experimental materials in the eyes of the Holy Sect. Rage like venomous serpents gnawed at his rationality, yet his expression remained as calm as still water. 'Mo Xiansheng,' he asked in his heart, 'Can any of these people still be saved?' The remnant soul fell silent for a moment: 'Those whose extraction has passed the halfway mark—their souls are already destroyed, beyond redemption. But there are still more than a dozen whose Heavenly Fate remains intact. If extraction can be halted in time, perhaps...'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's voice came from behind, extremely low, yet unable to hide its trembling: 'Chen Ji, look over there.' She pointed toward the eastern side of the altar, where there was an area separately isolated, covered with even denser prohibition patterns. And at the center surrounded by those patterns, the silhouette of a young girl floated statically in mid-air—she had her eyes closed, surrounded by a faint golden glow. Her features vaguely overlapped with the little girl with double buns that lingered in Chen Ji's memory, yet also so unfamiliar that he could barely recognize her.

text.content: Chen Nian. His feet moved forward involuntarily, but immediately rebounded against a powerful force—the prohibition was far stronger than they had imagined. Even with Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul power, it would be difficult to break in a short time. Ye Qing frowned: 'Is this the... your sister you mentioned?' Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze locked死死 onto the ground beneath Chen Nian's feet, where a complex阵纹图纹 that could make one dizzy was carved—it was the core hub of the entire altar, the physical manifestation of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key itself.

dialogue.content: 'This old man should have told you long ago.' Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned heavy, 'Chen Nian was selected by the Holy Sect as the Lock Key because she carries blood similar to yours—Chen family has guarded the secret of the Tianji Record for generations, and the Lock Key must be someone blood-related to the Prophet. Her Heavenly Fate has already been mostly extracted. If this continues for another seven days, she will completely become fuel for opening that door. But if the prohibition is triggered now, the entire facility will immediately enter defensive mode, and everyone in every cocoon will be instantly drained dry—including your sister.'

text.content: Seven days. Still seven days. This realization稍微让陈机calm了一些，脑中的算盘飞速转动。他环顾四周，目光在祭坛的各个角落扫过，最终落在西侧一个不起眼的偏门上。那里站着一个杂役打扮的年轻人，正低头擦拭着什么，看似漫不经心，但陈机敏锐地察觉到对方的视线曾不止一次从陈念身上掠过。夜清也注意到了，whispered道：'我之前联络的内线，就是他。'

dialogue.content: 'His name is Zhou Chen, an Outer Disciple of the Holy Sect. Three months ago, I accidentally saved him when he was being pursued by the sect—only because he witnessed something he shouldn't have seen.' Ye Qing's voice dropped even lower, 'I thought he would be a good breakthrough point, but now it seems... he seems to be hesitating about something.' Chen Ji did not immediately respond. His gaze briefly met that of the young man named Zhou Chen. The other party's eyes dodged for a moment, then quickly lowered. Chen Ji sneered in his heart—this person knows something, and a lot of it.

text.content: 'What pretext did the Holy Sect use to capture my sister?' Chen Ji suddenly asked. Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: 'As far as this old man knows, they used your father's crime of defection back then—claiming he privately hoarded a Tianji Record Fragment, and the guilt extended to the whole family. Your sister was taken as a 'bonus' when 'confiscating the contraband.' You were too young then, with no idea what had happened.' A cold arc curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, an arc holding no hint of a smile, only bone-deep chilliness: 'What a fine Holy Sect, what fine 'contraband.' What my father protected with his life, they could not take; what about my sister, they也别想留住.'

choice.prompt: Facing the current situation, Chen Ji had to make a decision. He knew clearly that every step could be related to his sister's survival—

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to foresee the optimal rescue plan within the next three hours, even if it costs 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value may trigger the prohibition
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete rescue route, know all prohibition weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value is precious, prohibition backlash risk is unknown

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for a moment, activating the Tianji Record. A sharp pain stabbed at his brow center, and golden text flowed like water and浮现. Within three hours, infiltrating from the side door, assassinating patrol disciples,解除茧囊restriction, rescuing Chen Nian—every step clearly presented before him. However, at the end of the vision, he saw a harrowing scene: an elderly figure in black robes was walking out from the depths, that aura... was a Holy Sect Transformed God Stage Elder!

choices.text: First expose the Holy Sect's crimes
choices.description: Find evidence recording the Holy Sect's crimes, thoroughly expose this matter, make the Holy Sect a target for all.
choices.visible_cost: Need time to collect evidence, may miss the optimal rescue timing
choices.visible_reward: Obtain leverage against the Holy Sect, lay groundwork for later revenge
choices.risk_hint: Evidence may be destroyed, Ye Qing's identity exposed

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his voice and said to Ye Qing: 'You go stabilize that Zhou Chen first. I'll find a way to obtain some experimental records. Such an atrocity of evidence, if it can be spread, the Holy Sect will definitely become a target for all.' A hint of something strange flashed in Ye Qing's eyes, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to maintain such cold calculation at this moment. She nodded and turned to leave, while Chen Ji quietly approached the recording platform at the altar's edge.

choices.text: Conceal and lie in wait, first explore the true situation
choices.description: Not in a hurry to act, first use Zhou Chen to feel out the true depths of the Holy Sect, wait for a better opportunity.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as weak, younger sister suffers one more day
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence, concealed identity becomes more stable
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may become impatient, internal changes may occur

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed his inner impulse, his voice cold: "Not in a hurry." He gestured subtly toward Zhou Chen, "That man's gaze is off. He knows far more than he reveals. First understand how deep the Holy Sect's waters run, then striking won't be too late." Ye Qing slightly furrowed her brows but didn't retort. Chen Ji turned to her, his gaze profound: "Your insider, now is the time to demonstrate his value."

Ye Qing glided silently toward Zhou Chen, the two speaking in low voices in a corner. From Chen Ji's angle, he could see Zhou Chen's expression shifting unceasingly—first terror, then struggle, finally a kind of near-despairate resolve. He seemed to say something, Ye Qing's expression slightly changing as she glanced back at Chen Ji, shaking her head subtly. Chen Ji understood in his heart—this Zhou Chen would not be so easily controlled.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing returned, her voice pressed extremely low: "He says he knows some inside information, but he dares not say everything." She paused, as if weighing her words, "He says there's a bigger force behind this experiment—not something the Holy Sect's Sect Master can decide, but... from some existence we cannot imagine. He only overheard a single sentence and has been hunted ever since. If not for meeting me, he would have died long ago." Chen Ji's eyes stirred slightly: "What words?" Ye Qing took a deep breath: "He said—'The Eye of Heavenly Way is watching here.'"

text.content: The Eye of Heavenly Way. These four characters were like a basin of ice water poured over his head, Chen Ji felt his heart contract sharply. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng once said—the Tianji Record was merely one of many chess pieces laid out by Heavenly Way, and prophetic seers throughout history were all used as pieces. If Zhou Chen spoke truthfully, then what lay before him wasn't a simple sect conspiracy, but—"Indeed." Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded, rarely carrying a hint of solemnity, "The Heavenly Fate Lock Key plan was precisely to open a sealed door. And standing behind that door is the Eye of Heavenly Way. The Holy Sect is merely the executor it chose."

choice.prompt: The truth is more terrifying than imagined. Facing this earth-shaking conspiracy involving the Eye of Heavenly Way, Chen Ji must re-examine his plans—

choices.text: Ignore the Eye of Heavenly Way, proceed as originally planned
choices.description: No matter who stands behind it, the younger sister must be saved. Plan proceeds as is, small steps and quick pace, counter moves as they come.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the unknown existence, risks increase
choices.visible_reward: Maintain plan coherence, avoid startling the snake
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Way's gaze may bring variables

text.content: Chen Ji gave a cold laugh: "The Eye of Heavenly Way? What a grand title." His voice was low and dangerous, "It wants to open the door, I'll close it. It wants pieces, I'll overturn the chessboard instead." Mo Xiansheng seemed to want to say something, but ultimately just sighed and said no more. Chen Ji turned to Ye Qing: "Tell Zhou Chen, if he truly wants to live, let him spill everything he knows. I can guarantee his safety—but this chance comes only once."

choices.description: Since the opponent is the Eye of Heavenly Way, one must be even more cautious, plan from a long-term perspective, scheme in the shadows.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, once more activating the Tianji Record. This time what he saw wasn't rescue routes, but all possible variables within the next three hours—the patrol disciples' shift change times, Zhou Chen's betrayal possibilities, the Eye of Heavenly Way's possible reactions... Scenes flashed by like a carousel. When he opened his eyes, the depths of his gaze had become an icy abyss: "Plan changes. What I want is foolproof certainty, not nine deaths out of ten."

choices.text: Temporarily abandon Chen Nian, preserve the overall situation
choices.description: Chen Nian has already had most of her Heavenly Fate extracted. Even if rescued, recovery would be difficult. Might as well temporarily abandon and seek another method.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon the younger sister, deviating from original intention
choices.visible_reward: Preserve yourself, as long as the green mountains remain
choices.risk_hint: May be judged by the system as weak

text.content: No sooner had the words fallen than Chen Ji felt a剧烈 headache—Tianji Record was warning him that abandoning the bloodline connection with Chen Nian would shake the very foundation of his existence. He clutched his forehead, a bitter smile crossing his face: "It seems even Heaven won't let me make this choice." He took a deep breath. "Fine, I will save her, but I need a more thorough plan." Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment: "Finally, you said something like a human being."

Just then, a heavy footstep echoed from the depths of the altar. Ye Qing's face changed: "Someone's coming!" Chen Ji scanned his surroundings swiftly—the nearest cover was dozens of zhang away, and those footsteps were steady and powerful, certainly not an ordinary disciple. He made an instant judgment, pulling Ye Qing into the shadows while enveloping both their auras. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang urgently in his mind: "Too late, it's a Transformation God Stage aura—stronger than this old man's peak!"

The footsteps drew nearer. Through a gap in the shadows, Chen Ji saw an elderly man in ink-colored robes slowly entering the altar. His face was as withered as dead wood, his deep-set eyes blazing with sharp light, and the oppressive aura surrounding him made the air thick. The elder glanced at the cocoons around the altar, nodding slightly, as if quite satisfied with what he saw. Then his gaze shifted toward where Chen Nian floated, his gaunt lips curving into an eerie smile: "In three more days, the Lock Key will fully mature. Then, the blessing of the Eye of Heavenly Way shall descend upon our Holy Sect..."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stared fixedly at that withered face, carving every detail into his memory. Ye Qing felt the cold killing intent radiating from him, couldn't help but shudder, lowering her voice: "Stay calm. Your current strength is no match for his." Chen Ji gave no answer. His hand slowly reached into his embrace, touching the Tianji Record Fragment—as long as he consumed another 5 points of Heavenly Fate, he could foresee this elder's weakness. But he didn't immediately do so, for Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again: "Don't act rashly. This person is merely an outer sect elder of the Holy Sect. The true core area lies ahead."

choice.prompt: The Transformation God Stage elder is right before him, while his sister is behind him. Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.text: Activate Tianji Record, strike with a direct ambush
choices.description: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate to activate Tianji Record, obtain the elder's weakness information, take a reckless gamble.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji activated Tianji Record without hesitation, golden patterns flickering at his brow center. However, the moment information flooded into his mind, the elder at the altar suddenly turned his head, his profound gaze piercing directly toward where Chen Ji hid—"Who goes there?!" Mo Xiansheng exclaimed: "Bad, he sensed the aura of Tianji Record! Run!"

choices.text: Bide time and retreat, seek another opportunity
choices.description: A living person need not despair. Retreat first, gather more intelligence before making plans.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity, sister suffers another day
choices.risk_hint: May be discovered by the elder

text.content: Chen Ji quickly grabbed Ye Qing's hand, transmitting via aura: "Go." The two moved like phantoms toward the rear, skillfully using shadows and cocoons as cover. However, just as they were about to leave the altar, the stone slab beneath Ye Qing's foot let out a soft click—a mechanism trigger. The elder's gaze instantly locked onto them, his turbid eyes flickering with amusement: "The Holy Sect's Saint of the Demonic Path? Interesting... That orthodox sect disciple beside you, who is he?"

choices.description: Step out proactively, use the Tianji Record Fragment to create a false impression, disguise as a member from another faction coveting the Heavenly Fate Lock Key.
choices.visible_cost: Identity may be exposed, subsequent actions restricted
choices.visible_reward: Extract more information, gain the initiative
choices.risk_hint: The elder may see through the disguise

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gripped Ye Qing's wrist, slowly stepping out from the shadows, a perfectly calibrated expression of arrogance and greed appearing on his face: "This senior, surely you are a noble from the Holy Sect. This one merely passed by this place, wishing to see what this legendary Heavenly Fate Lock Key truly is... Never expected to disturb a senior like you, truly失礼." The elder narrowed his eyes, examining Chen Ji up and down, then suddenly coldly laughed: "Passing by? The aura you carry, doesn't seem like that of someone merely passing by."

text.content: The old man took a step forward, and the mountain-like pressure instantly enveloped the entire altar. Chen Ji felt as if he was being crushed by an invisible giant mountain, his breath becoming difficult. Yet there was no trace of fear on his face; instead, a playful smile curved his lips: "Why must the senior be angry? Though my cultivation is low, I have heard that the Holy Sect is plotting a major event—if the senior acts now, wouldn't that scare the prey and ruin your great plans?" The old man paused mid-step, a flicker of surprise crossing his eyes, as if he hadn't expected a Foundation Building ant to remain so composed before him.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The old man withdrew some of his oppressive aura, his withered fingers tapping lightly beside him. "Foundation Building cultivation, yet you possess such boldness... Who exactly are you?" Chen Ji lowered his gaze, concealing the coldness in his eyes: "I am merely a wandering cultivator who happened upon a fragmented scroll, following its clues here. If the senior does not believe me, you may probe my soul—though in doing so, you would never know where this fragment leads." A sharp gleam flashed in the old man's eyes. After a moment of silence, he suddenly burst into laughter: "Bold spirit! I am Ling Yuanshan, Law Enforcement Elder of the Holy Sect. I shall remember you today. If you truly possess the ability to obtain that fragmented scroll, I await your arrival."

text.content: "Ling Yuanshan. Law Enforcement Elder." Chen Ji carved this name into the deepest recesses of his mind, his expression revealing nothing as he respectfully took his leave. Just as he turned, the old man's voice rang out once more, this time carrying a meaningfully ominous warning: "By the way, relay a message for me to that demonic path saint—her audacity in infiltrating the Holy Sect as a saint is remarkable. Should I encounter her again, I will not be so lenient." Ye Qing's face paled, her fists instinctively clenching. Chen Ji gently pressed her hand, speaking in a voice only the two of them could hear: "Noted. Let's go."

The two slipped out through the side door, Ling Yuanshan's leisurely laughter echoing behind them. That laughter reverberated through the empty altar like the hiss of a venomous serpent, sending a fine layer of cold sweat prickling across Chen Ji's back. Only after they had completely left that blood-soaked place did Ye Qing release a long, shuddering breath, her voice carrying a trace of lingering fear: "That old monster... His strength must be half a step into the Unity Transformation stage." Chen Ji offered no reply. His gaze turned toward some distant direction, and a dangerous curve slowly formed at the corner of his mouth: "Ling Yuanshan... Law Enforcement Elder of the Holy Sect, very well, I remember you." His voice was calm as still water, yet it caused Ye Qing to inexplicably shudder—she suddenly realized that this seemingly worthless orthodox sect disciple had quietly woven an immense net of conspiracy.
